name: Koadr
description: Canonical facts about Koadr, an open-architecture, agentic AI workspace that turns natural language into production-ready full-stack apps inside the browser.

items.value: An open-architecture, agentic AI workspace that turns natural language into production-ready full-stack apps, instantly, inside the browser.
A real Node.js stack runs client-side using WebContainers. No local setup and no remote VM per user.
Model-agnostic with 22+ providers, including local models via Ollama and LM Studio. Bring your own keys.
0 EUR on hosted koadr.dev, with limited cloud-synced projects, storage, history and deployments.
9.90 EUR per month or 99 EUR per year, with unlimited projects, cloud sync, custom domains and priority support.
0 EUR. Open source under the MIT license; you run and maintain your own server.
BYOK: users pay their AI provider directly for model usage. Koadr does not mark up model usage.
